scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 41 opening frames (the run's events.jsonl cut after the first state row of the turn, replayed at that turn) of two Deity Diplomatic-lane games of 2026-11-18 while the seat was a member of a scored competition: civvis-20261118T055703Z (Gaul; Aid Request t125-145, World Games t130-147 in which no member scored, a second Aid Request and the Space Station from t160) and civvis-20261118T061033Z (Hungary; Aid Request t115-130, World Games t133-153 with our score 0, Aid Request t165-182). Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed --explain built from the branch at 3c6f381228 with the run's own requested genome (why.log line 1 forced); the on arm adds --with diplo-seat-claims-the-competition. Orders differ on 28 of 41 frames. Off arms put a competition project into production once in the 41 frames and name one as a city's next item 26 times (a hint, which starts nothing); on arms put one into production 22 times (Send Aid 12, Training Athletes 10) with the same 26 hints, and journal 29 'claims ... for the competition' lines. 13 frames read identical. A one-shot replay starts from the host's queue each frame, so it shows the claim being made, not the project being held to its end.
